Now that the difficulty issues have been fixed, Back 4 Blood is easy to recommend for Left 4 Dead fans looking for a modern spiritual successor.

As a huge fan of Left 4 Dead and Left 4 Dead 2, I was really excited for this one.  I played Back 4 Blood when it first came out and it 100% scratched that itch that the Left 4 Dead games left, with one problem, the difficulty.  Even on "recruit," the lowest difficulty setting in Back 4 Blood was too overwhelmed by special type zombies and many players including myself struggled and ultimately dropped the game.  I know I should "get good" and to be honest that's fair.  By extension of being closer to 40 than 30 I'm not as good at shooters as I used to be, but I'm OK with that.  I still wanna' shoot video game zombies, that didn't go away with age.

I got the itch to mow down some zombies recently and thanks to Humble Bundle I have a Steam copy of Back 4 Blood - so I tried this game in 2023.  I'm happy to report a great single player experience with the prior balance issues fixed.  My only complaint about multiplayer is that too few people playing in late 2023.

This game is amazing! 
I really feel like this is evolved left4dead. Weak spots, high-detailed weapon system, a lot of new zombie types, zombie bosses, a lot of new weapons, weapon shop, weapon mods. 
Amazing job!
I really can't understand what's wrong with you people, why you put so much critic on this masterpiece...
I know, there are few issues, and I will mention them, but it definitely not mean that this game should be underestimated so much
only one reasonable issue I can mention:
- for long time, there is not correction for replenish of maxHP. It is too hard to do that.
Game is fun and it's cross platform. If anyone needs people to play with, Feel free to add me.
